mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_schedules (id, organization_id, agent_id, user_id, name, prompt, skill_id, conversation_mode, conversation_id, timezone, kind, cron_expr, run_at, next_run_at, last_run_at, status, consecutive_failures, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{agentId}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{prompt}, #{skillId}, #{conversationMode}, #{conversationId}, #{timezone}, #{kind}, #{cronExpr}, #{runAt}, #{nextRunAt}, #{lastRunAt}, #{status}, #{consecutiveFailures}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_schedules SET name = #{name}, prompt = #{prompt}, skill_id = #{skillId}, conversation_mode = #{conversationMode}, conversation_id = #{conversationId}, timezone = #{timezone}, kind = #{kind}, cron_expr = #{cronExpr}, run_at = #{runAt}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, last_run_at = #{lastRunAt}, status = #{status}, consecutive_failures = #{consecutiveFailures}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND organization_id = #{organizationId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_schedules WHERE status = 'active' AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at <= now() ORDER BY next_run_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_schedules SET next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, last_run_at = #{lastRunAt}, status = #{status}, consecutive_failures = #{consecutiveFailures}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'active'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_schedule_runs (id, schedule_id, organization_id, conversation_id, user_message_id, due_at, claimed_at, status, error) VALUES (#{id}, #{scheduleId}, #{organizationId}, #{conversationId}, #{userMessageId}, #{dueAt}, #{claimedAt}, #{status}, #{error})
mapper.select: SELECT m.status FROM agent_schedule_runs r INNER JOIN agent_messages m ON m.id = r.user_message_id WHERE r.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND r.user_message_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.claimed_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1
